' ---- [modPricing.CalculateLineTotal] Function CalculateLineTotal (analysis: Computes line total after tier and volume discounts, capped by a maximum discount.) ----
Public Function CalculateLineTotal(ByRef line As OrderLine, ByVal tier As CustomerTier) As Double
    Dim gross As Double
    Dim discountRate As Double

    gross = line.Quantity * line.UnitPrice
    discountRate = GetTierDiscount(tier) + GetVolumeDiscount(line.Quantity)
    If discountRate > MAX_TOTAL_DISCOUNT Then discountRate = MAX_TOTAL_DISCOUNT

    ' VBA Round uses banker's rounding (round half to even)
    CalculateLineTotal = Round(gross * (1 - discountRate), 2)
End Function

rule kind: calculation

Weight tiers: ≤1 kg → 4.99, ≤5 kg → 9.99, ≤20 kg → 19.99, above 20 kg → 19.99 + 0.75 × (excess kg). Express shipping doubles the cost. Result rounded to two decimals.
VBA source:
' ---- [modPricing.CalculateShipping] Function CalculateShipping (analysis: Calculates shipping cost based on subtotal, weight, and express option, with free shipping threshold.) ----
Public Function CalculateShipping(ByVal subtotal As Double, ByVal weightKg As Double, _
                                  ByVal expressShipping As Boolean) As Double
    Dim cost As Double

    If subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD And Not expressShipping Then
        CalculateShipping = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    If weightKg <= 1 Then
        cost = 4.99
    ElseIf weightKg <= 5 Then
        cost = 9.99
    ElseIf weightKg <= 20 Then
        cost = 19.99
    Else
        cost = 19.99 + (weightKg - 20) * 0.75
    End If

    If expressShipping Then cost = cost * 2
    CalculateShipping = Round(cost, 2)
End Function

' ---- [modPricing.ApplyPromoCode] Function ApplyPromoCode (analysis: Applies promotional discount to subtotal based on promo code.) ----
Private Function ApplyPromoCode(ByVal subtotal As Double, ByVal promoCode As String) As Double
    Select Case UCase$(Trim$(promoCode))

        Case "SAVE20"

rule kind: calculation

' ---- [modPricing.CalculateOrderTotal] Function CalculateOrderTotal (analysis: Aggregates line totals, applies promo code, adds shipping and tax to produce final order total.) ----
Public Function CalculateOrderTotal(ByRef lines() As OrderLine, ByVal tier As CustomerTier, _
                                    ByVal region As String, ByVal weightKg As Double, _
                                    ByVal expressShipping As Boolean, _
                                    Optional ByVal promoCode As String = "") As Double
    Dim i As Long
    Dim subtotal As Double
    Dim shipping As Double
    Dim tax As Double

    For i = LBound(lines) To UBound(lines)
        subtotal = subtotal + CalculateLineTotal(lines(i), tier)
    Next i

    subtotal = Round(ApplyPromoCode(subtotal, promoCode), 2)
    shipping = CalculateShipping(subtotal, weightKg, expressShipping)
    tax = Round(subtotal * GetTaxRate(region), 2)

    CalculateOrderTotal = subtotal + shipping + tax
End Function

' ---- [modInventory.NeedsReorder] Function NeedsReorder (analysis: Determines whether inventory needs to be reordered based on on‑hand quantity, reorder point, lead time, and average daily usage.) ----
Public Function NeedsReorder(ByVal onHand As Long, ByVal reorderPoint As Long, _
                             ByVal leadTimeDays As Long, ByVal avgDailyUsage As Double) As Boolean
    Dim projected As Double
    projected = onHand - (leadTimeDays * avgDailyUsage)

signature: public int SuggestedOrderQty(int onHand, int leadTimeDays, decimal avgDailyUsage, int packSize)
rule kind: calculation

description: Computes the recommended purchase quantity, rounding up to the nearest pack size and adding a safety buffer based on lead time and average daily usage.
VBA source:
' ---- [modInventory.SuggestedOrderQty] Function SuggestedOrderQty (analysis: Calculates the recommended order quantity, rounding up to the nearest pack size and applying a safety buffer.) ----
Public Function SuggestedOrderQty(ByVal onHand As Long, ByVal leadTimeDays As Long, _
                                  ByVal avgDailyUsage As Double, ByVal packSize As Long) As Long
    Dim target As Double
    Dim needed As Double
    Dim packs As Long

    If packSize <= 0 Then packSize = 1
    target = avgDailyUsage * (leadTimeDays + SAFETY_DAYS)
    needed = target - onHand
    If needed <= 0 Then
        SuggestedOrderQty = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    packs = Int(needed / packSize)
    If packs * packSize < needed Then packs = packs + 1
    SuggestedOrderQty = packs * packSize
End Function

' ---- [modInventory.DaysOfStock] Function DaysOfStock (analysis: Estimates how many days current inventory will last given average daily usage, with a safeguard for zero usage.) ----
Public Function DaysOfStock(ByVal onHand As Long, ByVal avgDailyUsage As Double) As Long
    Dim days As Long
    If avgDailyUsage <= 0 Then
        DaysOfStock = 9999
        Exit Function
    End If
    Do While onHand > 0 And days < 9999
        onHand = onHand - CLng(avgDailyUsage + 0.5)
        days = days + 1
        If onHand <= 0 Then Exit Do
    Loop
    DaysOfStock = days
End Function

' ---- [modFinance.MonthlyPayment] Function MonthlyPayment (analysis: Calculates the monthly payment for a loan given principal, annual rate, and term in years.) ----
Public Function MonthlyPayment(ByVal principal As Double, ByVal annualRatePct As Double, _
                               ByVal years As Long) As Double
    Dim r As Double
    Dim n As Long

    n = years * 12
    If n <= 0 Then
        MonthlyPayment = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    r = annualRatePct / 100 / 12
    If r = 0 Then
        MonthlyPayment = Round(principal / n, 2)
    Else
        MonthlyPayment = Round(principal * r / (1 - (1 + r) ^ (-n)), 2)
    End If
End Function

kind: rule
signature: public List<string> BuildAmortization(decimal principal, decimal annualRatePct, int years)
rule kind: calculation
description: Generates a full amortization schedule as a two‑dimensional array (period, interest, principal, remaining balance) for each month of the loan term, rounding monetary values to two decimals.
VBA source:
' ---- [modFinance.BuildAmortization] Function BuildAmortization (analysis: Generates an amortization schedule array for a loan.) ----
Public Function BuildAmortization(ByVal principal As Double, ByVal annualRatePct As Double, _
                                  ByVal years As Long) As Variant
    Dim n As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim payment As Double
    Dim balance As Double
    Dim interest As Double
    Dim schedule() As Double

    n = years * 12
    payment = MonthlyPayment(principal, annualRatePct, years)
    balance = principal
    ReDim schedule(1 To n, 1 To 4)

    For i = 1 To n
        interest = Round(balance * annualRatePct / 100 / 12, 2)
        If i = n Then payment = balance + interest   ' final payment clears the balance
        schedule(i, 1) = i
        schedule(i, 2) = interest
        schedule(i, 3) = payment - interest
        balance = Round(balance - (payment - interest), 2)
        schedule(i, 4) = balance
    Next i
    BuildAmortization = schedule
End Function

signature: public decimal NetPresentValue(decimal ratePct, List<string> cashFlows)
rule kind: calculation
description: Calculates the net present value of a series of cash flows discounted at a given annual rate (percent), summing each cash flow divided by (1+rate) raised to the period offset, rounding to two decimals.
VBA source:
' ---- [modFinance.NetPresentValue] Function NetPresentValue (analysis: Calculates the net present value of a series of cash flows at a given discount rate.) ----
Public Function NetPresentValue(ByVal ratePct As Double, ByRef cashFlows() As Double) As Double
    Dim i As Long
    Dim npv As Double
    For i = LBound(cashFlows) To UBound(cashFlows)
        npv = npv + cashFlows(i) / (1 + ratePct / 100) ^ (i - LBound(cashFlows))
    Next i
    NetPresentValue = Round(npv, 2)
End Function

' ---- [modText.NormalizeSku] Function NormalizeSku (analysis: Converts a raw SKU to uppercase, replaces spaces and underscores with hyphens, and truncates to 12 characters) ----
Public Function NormalizeSku(ByVal rawSku As String) As String
    Dim s As String
    s = UCase$(Trim$(rawSku))
    s = Replace(s, " ", "-")
    s = Replace(s, "_", "-")
    If Len(s) > 12 Then s = Left$(s, 12)
    NormalizeSku = s
End Function

id: RUL-019

signature: public bool IsValidEmail(string email)
rule kind: validation
description: Checks that an email address contains exactly one '@' and a '.' after the '@' and before the end of the string
VBA source:
' ---- [modText.IsValidEmail] Function IsValidEmail (analysis: Validates an email address format by checking positions of '@' and '.' characters) ----
Public Function IsValidEmail(ByVal email As String) As Boolean
    Dim atPos As Long
    Dim dotPos As Long
    email = Trim$(email)
    atPos = InStr(email, "@")
    If atPos < 2 Then Exit Function
    If InStr(atPos + 1, email, "@") > 0 Then Exit Function
    dotPos = InStrRev(email, ".")
    IsValidEmail = (dotPos > atPos + 1) And (dotPos < Len(email))
End Function

' ---- [modText.ToTitleCase] Function ToTitleCase (analysis: Converts a string to title case by capitalizing the first letter of each word) ----
Public Function ToTitleCase(ByVal text As String) As String
    Dim words() As String
    Dim i As Long
    words = Split(LCase$(Trim$(text)), " ")
    For i = LBound(words) To UBound(words)
        If Len(words(i)) > 0 Then
            words(i) = UCase$(Left$(words(i), 1)) & Mid$(words(i), 2)
        End If
    Next i
    ToTitleCase = Join(words, " ")
End Function

id: RUL-021
kind: rule
signature: public bool IsValidLuhn(string digits)
rule kind: validation
description: Validates a numeric string using the Luhn algorithm (checksum)
VBA source:
' ---- [modText.IsValidLuhn] Function IsValidLuhn (analysis: Validates a numeric string using the Luhn algorithm) ----
Public Function IsValidLuhn(ByVal digits As String) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    Dim d As Long
    Dim total As Long
    Dim doubleIt As Boolean

    digits = Replace(digits, " ", "")
    If Len(digits) < 2 Then Exit Function
    For i = Len(digits) To 1 Step -1
        If Mid$(digits, i, 1) < "0" Or Mid$(digits, i, 1) > "9" Then Exit Function
        d = CLng(Mid$(digits, i, 1))
        If doubleIt Then
            d = d * 2
            If d > 9 Then d = d - 9
        End If
        total = total + d
        doubleIt = Not doubleIt
    Next i
    IsValidLuhn = (total Mod 10 = 0)
End Function

' ---- [modReporting.ParseTier] Function ParseTier (analysis: Converts a tier description string to the corresponding CustomerTier enum value) ----
Private Function ParseTier(ByVal text As String) As CustomerTier
    Select Case LCase$(Trim$(text))
        Case "silver": ParseTier = tierSilver
        Case "gold": ParseTier = tierGold
        Case "platinum": ParseTier = tierPlatinum
        Case Else: ParseTier = tierStandard
    End Select
End Function
